moworks.notes: Split words; each word opacity 0 → 1 and blur 10 → 0 px over 0.5–1 s ease-out (demo 0.8 s easeOutQuad; CSS 1 s), 0.2 s apart (demo capped 2 s total), from 0.5 s. Demo shows it in an AI-chat card (26 px, left aligned) with three typing dots bobbing ±1.5 px that fade 0.4–0.55 s before the text; loop exit fade 3.7–4.0 s; loop 4.2 s. Params: duration: mỗi từ (0.8 s) · stagger (0.2 s) · blur (10 px).
